_comment: Pathfinder's custom Windows 11 security baseline. This is a project-defined policy, not an official CIS benchmark.
_rules_comment: Each rule identifies a security check, its required status, the severity of non-compliance, and the security requirement.

rules._comment: Windows Firewall should be enabled for all three network profiles.
rules.description: All Windows Firewall profiles must be enabled.

rules._comment: SMBv1 is an obsolete file-sharing protocol with significant security weaknesses.
rules.description: SMBv1 server support must be disabled.

rules._comment: Remote Desktop must either be disabled or meet the security conditions checked by RDP-001.
rules.description: Remote Desktop must be disabled or configured securely.

rules._comment: User Account Control helps restrict administrative elevation.
rules.description: User Account Control must be configured securely.

rules._comment: Disk encryption reduces exposure of stored data following device loss or theft.
rules.description: All assessed volumes must have active full-disk encryption.
